# @tenets/env

> 标签: JavaScript

## 简介

Composable typed environment contracts on Zod 4.6 with a cached schema per definition, server/client partitions, deployed-environment rules, and an optional Next.js adapter — the boundary-validation layer the tenets ruleset prescribes (Rule 2.1).
